title: node-info
description: Payload published retained by each Node to renewvan/<node>/info (three segments, so it is never mistaken for a four-segment entity topic). The Node's manifest (node-manifest.schema.json) plus a REQUIRED build-stamped version and an OPTIONAL host_serial. Published on every connect immediately before 'online' on renewvan/<node>/health, and left retained when the Node goes offline so consumers can show 'offline, last seen <version>'. Home Assistant field mapping, for anyone bridging Node info to an HA device block (documented here only; nothing HA-shaped goes on the wire): product -> model, version -> sw_version, host_serial -> serial_number, homepage -> configuration_url, node -> identifiers. host_serial is a support identity for display, never a join key, and every Node on one Host publishes the same value. Formats seen so far: (1) a Raspberry Pi SoC serial, the Serial line of /proc/cpuinfo, 16 hex digits such as 10000000abcdef01; (2) an ESP32 MAC address as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF. It is omitted, never faked or 'unknown', when it cannot be read or is empty or all zeros.

node.description: The Node's key; must equal the <node> topic segment this payload is published under. A lowercase slug with no node- prefix. The reserved key 'demo' is rejected: it is the Demo namespace root, never a Node.

product.description: Human-readable product name shown as the Node's title (Home Assistant: model).

source.description: What the Node reads: the hardware or feed it senses or remaps.

publishes.description: Entity types the Node publishes. Same static enum as node-manifest.schema.json, kept in sync with the entity schemas by schema/validate-examples.sh.

manufacturer.description: Optional. Who makes the Node. Consumers show 'renewvan' when Node info exists without one.

homepage.description: Optional. Project or product URL (Home Assistant: configuration_url).

version.description: Build-stamped version (Home Assistant: sw_version): the git release tag for a Python Node, the 'git describe --tags --always --dirty' string for the ESP32 relay, or the literal 'dev' when no version was stamped. Never read from the manifest.

host_serial.description: Optional. Serial of the Host the Node runs on (Home Assistant: serial_number); free string, minimum length 1. See the schema description for the two formats seen. Omitted when unavailable.
